exact_blocker: No terminal purpose-specific evaluation reservation authority currently provides even one pristine eligible code object, much less objects from two independent code families. EVAL-289 has an inactive empty reservation and its legacy httpx/requests candidates were already exposed to model training. Newly admitted NEXT100 code sources checked here are training authorities or explicitly lack evaluation authorization/reservation. Therefore a non-empty immutable evaluation JSONL cannot be lawfully or contamination-safely produced.

live_authority_findings.non_terminal_or_non_evaluation_branch_no: Additional concurrent code-source branches are not admissible here unless a terminal purpose-specific evaluation reservation authority binds exact objects before any tokenizer/training exposure. Branch existence or training authority is insufficient.

selection.deterministic_rule: Filter terminal purpose-specific evaluation reservation authorities by exact rights, exact immutable identity, pre-exposure reservation, zero tokenizer/training exposure, and zero training overlap; sort by source_family/repository/revision/path/git_blob_sha1/raw_sha256; select the first eligible object from each independent family until two families are present.

jsonl.reason: Prerequisites are not satisfied; publishing an evaluation JSONL would fabricate eligibility.

unblock_requirements: Create a terminal purpose-specific evaluation-use authority for exact pinned code objects from at least two independent canonical source families.
Bind each object to repository, exact revision, path, Git blob SHA-1, raw SHA-256, license/rights evidence, and explicit evaluation-use permission.
Publish an active reservation for those exact identities before any tokenizer fit, corpus construction, model training, selection tuning, or benchmark outcome access.
Prove zero historical tokenizer exposure and zero historical model-training exposure for each reserved object.
Exclude every reserved raw/normalized/content identity from all current and future training inventories and prove zero overlap.
Re-run deterministic selection using authority metadata only; do not access final-test payloads or outcomes.
